proved: The Rust-owned request targets exactly /v1/messages, sends x-api-key and anthropic-version: 2023-06-01, omits bearer authorization, and sets stream:true.
The transport requires text/event-stream, enforces the shared 32 MiB aggregate ceiling, and remains inside the existing absolute request timeout and caller cancellation future.
The incremental decoder normalizes message start, text delta, cumulative usage, stop reason, provider warning/error, and message stop while tolerating ping and unknown future event types.
Thinking, signature, and partial-tool bodies are omitted from normalized events; provider error messages are reduced to a sanitized type code.
Malformed labels, decreasing cumulative usage, malformed/truncated frames, and incomplete or out-of-order lifecycle events fail closed.

The native task runtime accumulates a bounded Anthropic response, removes the cancellation registration, marks the content-free run record as streamed, and excludes secret, prompt, category, and private-thinking canaries.
The workspace remote-review routing selects the native stream path for OpenAI and Anthropic while leaving Gemini and xAI on bounded one-shot generation.
